name: The Dark Saga
storyline: The mod tells the story of Alaster and his friend Marik. One day, in a Vengard tavern, they hear about a legendary weapon from a drunken pirate, and later acquire a map marked with a powerful artifact - the Black Sword. During a journey to a mysterious island, they are attacked by pirates. When they try to escape, they discover that the crew of their ship are actually pirates in disguise. A fight breaks out on board between the captain and the crew, after which the heroes jump overboard and sail towards a nearby island. There, they learn that the sea dogs, who had been anticipating this turn of events, have already arrived ashore. Alaster and Marik are sold into slavery. From then on, they strive to escape orcish captivity and acquire a powerful treasure.
summary:
The story narrates about Alaster and Marik, new heroes who plunged into adventure. They decided to make their life of idleness in Vanguard more varied and exciting. Searching of an ancient treasure was their main purpose but the destiny has her own thoughts on them. So they will get a lot more than originally planned.

Features:
- new worlds like: arge island, three-leveled ore mine, ancient fort dungeons
- 5 fractions with unique quests: slaves, orc mercenary, ferocian hunters, paladins and pirates
- new monsters, animations, skills
- approximately 300 pages long scenario containing over 90 quests
- around 40 hours of gameplay
